additional_info.subject: RE: ID0470135-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S7 313806942001]Check on logs CRM:02681001288
additional_info.body:
Buon pomeriggio Rosita,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0470135.
The ticket was opened for a failed session authenticated with POS.
Following my colleague's answer, I confirm that the issue is with the authentication via POS, and from charger side we do not see anything else. As you can see from the logs below, the client plugged in the vehicle, the charger started the P01_authentication phase (waiting for authorization from the POS). This authorization did not arrive, hence the session failed.
The customer tried other #4 times afterwards, all with the same results: charger did not receive the authorization from POS.
As you know, the
IM30 PAX terminal is integrated in our Sicharge D as a Cloud Payment terminal. Therefore, from Sicharge D side we do not have visibility at all of the Payment process and authorization.
The communication sequence is the following: POS  --> Fortech --> NTT Data Backend --> Sicharge D (via OCPP). Therefore, from charger side, we only receive a RemoteStartTransaction when the authorization and payment process is successful and communicated from the Backend to the charger. We do not have visibility of any failed payment, as all this communication is limited between the POS and Fortech
.
The charger received a RemoteStartTransaction in the last attempt at 16:07, but as you can see the authentication process was wrong, as the client connected DC2 (outlet id=1), and authorized for outlet id=2 (DC1).
For what concerns the charging of 4.50 EUR and the subsequent partial reversal, again we do not have visibility of that, as it is managed by the POS itself.
If you need further information, I would recommend to reach out to the Payment provider.
Hope I provided you with clarification to your query. Please let me know if I can proceed to close the ticket, or if further support on the topic is required.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
